changes.reason: OSS-REVIEW-FIXES-3 (2026-10-10, review OSS-PKCE-REVIEW R3, judge ruling (a)): new rule FRONTCHANNEL-FANOUT-MIXED-1, armed on internal/handlers/logout_frontchannel_mixed_fanout_test.go @ unit. On the end_session front-channel fan-out every frame gets one sandbox: allow-scripts allow-same-origin only when every receiver is positively off the issuer's origin; when any receiver is on the issuer's origin, on an internationalized host, on a host with a character other than a letter, digit, hyphen or dot, or on an origin that cannot be canonicalized with certainty, every frame gets allow-scripts alone, in either receiver order. Red-proved on 219b6e3 through the real end-session handler, and in a browser on a scratch stack.

Red-proved on 20bf9d4 (22 refused URLs accepted) and by two mutations of the guard.
